name: yuanbao-websearch
description: Web search through Tencent Yuanbao's MCP endpoint (SearchPro): Chinese and mixed-language queries, vertical sources (Mode=1) for realtime data like gold prices and weather, freshness filters. Requires the YUANBAO_API_KEY environment variable.

description_i18n.en: Web search through Tencent Yuanbao's MCP endpoint (SearchPro): Chinese and mixed-language queries, vertical sources (Mode=1) for realtime data like gold prices and weather, freshness filters. Requires the YUANBAO_API_KEY environment variable.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 经腾讯元宝 MCP 端点联网搜索（SearchPro）：中文与中英混合查询、垂直权威信源（Mode=1，金价/天气等实时数据）、时效过滤。需要环境变量 YUANBAO_API_KEY。
